lines: Both wheels bound but, branch-ends-supporting; from root place as, goddess, darkness-knot should tear.
l4.sanskrit_cite: cakrobhayanibaddhāṃ tu śākhāprāntāvalambinīm mūlasthānādyathā devi tamogranthiṃ vidārayet
